data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-time Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard using Chart.js to display live metrics such as LLM cost, stage completion, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard updates in real-time with new data
LLM cost is displayed using a line chart
Stage completion rates are shown with a bar chart
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features
features.description: Highlight key features of Artemis such as cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning with supporting charts.
acceptance_criteria: Cost tracking feature is demonstrated with a chart
Sandboxing and learning features are clearly explained
Charts are used to effectively communicate feature metrics

features.title: Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize various metrics such as pipeline stages, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are displayed using a Chart.js line chart
Cost tracking is visualized with a Chart.js bar chart
Success rates are shown using a Chart.js area chart

features.title: Professional Design
features.description: Apply a professional gradient background and smooth transitions to enhance visual appeal.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is applied consistently across slides
Transitions between slides are smooth and professional
Design aligns with existing company branding

features.title: Auto-advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality with navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set time interval
Users can manually navigate between slides using controls
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive

features.title: Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file that includes embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for a self-contained demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file contains all necessary CSS and JavaScript within the file
Chart.js is included and functional within the HTML
File is named artemis_demo_chartjs.html and saved to /tmp/

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and adherence to SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD compliance metrics
SOLID principles adherence is visualized
Chart is clear and easy to interpret

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show integration of supervisor across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents supervisor integration
Chart is interactive and responds to user input
Data is sourced from recent integration metrics
